testcase.name: Scenario: End Pan using its context menu: tmp/obk-pan-48987af/features/application/viewport-pan/viewport-pan.feature:26:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: End Pan using its context menu ✔ Given a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar ✔ When the user right-clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then a contextual menu offers Done, OK, Home View, Orbit, Zoom and Previous View ✔ And the status area still indicates Pan is active ✔ When the user chooses Done ✔ Then the contextual menu closes and the status area displays Ready ✔ And the same part and solid remain visible
